about.blurb: A free NURBS, SubD and mesh modeler with Rhino 8's command vocabulary. Totally free: no subscription, no payment, no licence keys, no accounts, no telemetry.
about.kernel: Geometry kernel: OpenNURBS (McNeel, MIT licence) + Manifold (Apache 2.0)
about.file_format: Native file format: .3dm (reads and writes Rhino 8 files)
about.keyboard: Keyboard: F1 command list, F2 history, F3 properties, F7 grid, F8 ortho, F9 grid snap, F10 control points, Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo, Esc cancel.
options.title: Options
options.general_intro: Dino 8 has no licence, update-check or account settings: there is nothing to configure here that could ever lock you out.
options.theme_high_contrast_hint: High Contrast: WCAG-AA-ish text/background contrast, and hover/selected/disabled states shown with outlines, not just colour.
options.show_welcome: Show the welcome card on empty documents
statusbar.tip.current_layer: Current layer: new objects go here. Click to change.
statusbar.tip.grid_snap: Snap picked points to the grid (F9)
statusbar.tip.planar: Keep picks at the elevation of the previous point
statusbar.tip.gumball: Drag selected objects with the on-screen gumball
cmddesc.point: Creates point objects at picked locations.
cmddesc.line: Draws a line segment between two picked points.
cmddesc.polyline: Draws a polyline through picked points, with options for arc segments and closing.
cmddesc.circle: Draws a circle from a center and radius, with diameter, three-point and tangent options.
cmddesc.arc: Draws an arc from center, start and end points.
cmddesc.ellipse: Draws an ellipse from its center and the end points of its two axes.
cmddesc.rectangle: Draws a rectangle from two opposite corner points.
cmddesc.curve: Draws a curve from picked control points, with degree and closing options.
cmddesc.interpcrv: Draws a curve that passes through the picked points.
cmddesc.move: Moves selected objects from a base point to a target point.
cmddesc.copy: Copies selected objects from a base point to one or more target points.
cmddesc.rotate: Rotates selected objects about a center point by a picked or typed angle.
cmddesc.scale: Scales selected objects uniformly about a base point by a typed or picked factor.
cmddesc.mirror: Reflects selected objects across a mirror line or plane, optionally keeping the originals.
cmddesc.array: Copies objects into a grid of rows, columns and levels with chosen spacing.
cmddesc.arraylinear: Copies objects in a straight line at a set count and spacing.
cmddesc.arraypolar: Copies objects around a center point at a set count and total angle.
cmddesc.orient: Moves, rotates and optionally scales objects from reference points onto target points.
cmddesc.trim: Trims curves where they cross other curves, including apparent intersections.
cmddesc.extend: Extends the end of each curve nearer a picked point until its tangent reaches that point.
cmddesc.join: Joins curves end to end into polycurves, and surfaces along shared edges into polysurfaces.
cmddesc.explode: Breaks selected objects into their component parts.
cmddesc.fillet: Rounds the corner between two curves with an arc of a given radius.
cmddesc.filletedge: Rounds selected solid edges with a rolling-ball fillet.
cmddesc.chamfer: Bevels the corner between two curves with chosen distances.
cmddesc.chamferedge: Bevels selected solid edges with chosen distances.
cmddesc.offset: Creates parallel copies of curves at a typed distance or toward a picked side.
cmddesc.offsetsrf: Creates surfaces parallel to selected ones at a given distance.
cmddesc.box: Creates a box from base corners and a height.
cmddesc.sphere: Creates a sphere from a center and a radius or diameter.
cmddesc.cylinder: Creates a cylinder from a base circle and a height.
cmddesc.cone: Creates a cone from a base circle and a height.
cmddesc.extrudecrv: Extrudes selected curves along the construction-plane normal by a typed or picked distance.
cmddesc.extrudesrf: Extrudes selected surfaces by a distance into solids.
cmddesc.booleanunion: Merges the selected solids into one solid.
cmddesc.booleandifference: Subtracts the second set of solids from the first set.
cmddesc.booleanintersection: Keeps only the volume shared by the selected solids.
cmddesc.cap: Closes open planar boundaries of selected surfaces with planar caps to form a solid.
cmddesc.loft: Builds a surface that passes exactly through selected curves in order.
cmddesc.sweep1: Sweeps cross-section curves along one rail curve to build a surface.
cmddesc.sweep2: Sweeps cross-section curves along two rail curves to build a surface.
cmddesc.revolve: Rotates curves around an axis to create a surface of revolution.
cmddesc.networksrf: Builds a surface from a network of curves.
cmddesc.show: Makes every hidden object visible again.
cmddesc.lock: Prevents the selected objects from being picked or edited until unlocked.
cmddesc.open: Opens a document from a file.
cmddesc.save: Saves the document to its file.
cmddesc.saveas: Saves the document under a new file name.
cmddesc.import: Reads a file into the current document.
cmddesc.export: Writes the selected objects to a file in a chosen format.
cmddesc.zoom: Changes the view magnification: window, all, extents, selected or dynamic.
cmddesc.pan: Moves the view sideways between two picked points.
cmddesc.setview: Sets the active viewport to a named standard view.
cmddesc.distance: Reports the distance between two picked points.
cmddesc.area: Reports the total area of selected surfaces, polysurfaces or meshes.
cmddesc.volume: Reports the volume of selected closed solids.
cmddesc.length: Reports the length of selected curves.
cmddesc.dim: Adds a linear dimension between two picked points.
cmddesc.text: Creates text from a typed string at a picked point.
cmddesc.leader: Draws a leader line from an arrowhead through bend points to a text label.
cmddesc.hatch: Fills closed curves with a hatch pattern from the pattern library.
cmddesc.undo: Reverses the most recent change to the document.
cmddesc.redo: Reapplies the most recently undone action.
cmddesc.group: Groups selected objects so they select and move together.
cmddesc.ungroup: Dissolves the selected groups, leaving their member objects.
cmddesc.block: Stores the selected geometry as a named block definition.
cmddesc.insert: Inserts a copy of a named block definition at a picked point.
